name: BBQ Cannellini Beans with Veggie Sausage & Napa Cabbage Coleslaw
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Peel and mince garlic. Place in a large bowl along with yogurt, mayo, vinegar, Dijon, sugar, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
Wash and dry cabbage. Trim off and discard the root end, halve lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Wash, dry, peel, and coarsely grate carrots; add to to the bowl and toss to combine the slaw. Set aside.
Arrange sausages on the baking sheet and place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated); bake, flipping once, until sausages are golden and warmed through, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Peel and mince additional garlic. Peel and small dice onion.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, drain and rinse beans.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and onion; cook, stirring often, until starting to soften, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place water, ketchup, vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, Dijon, and spices in a small bowl; whisk to combine the BBQ sauce.
Add beans and BBQ sauce to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring often, until liquid has reduced to a saucy consistency, about 5 minutes.
When the sausages are done, transfer to a cutting board and slice crosswise into rounds. Add to the skillet with the beans, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide slaw, beans, and sausage between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
